userStories.title: Deterministic plan_approval branch decision (operator pauses, auto proceeds) wired into cam-plan
userStories.description: As the auto safety surface, I need the post-audit action (pause for operator confirmation vs proceed to branch) decided by a deterministic TS helper driven by readPlanApproval, with cam-plan.md referencing that decision rather than reimplementing it in markdown, so that the human-gate logic cannot drift in prose.

cam-plan.md (both copies) references the deterministic TS decision after auditor APPROVE: operator mode pauses for a single plan confirmation before branch (Step 9); auto mode proceeds to branch with no operator gate. userStories.notes: VERTICAL SLICE: new notify client + terminal wiring + config surface (setup/config/Ink) + runbook. REQUIRES US-006 (the terminal it fires on) and US-001 (plan_approval). RESEND IS THE FIRST EXTERNAL RUNTIME DEP (spec gotcha 3): `bun add resend`, isolate behind src/notify/resend.ts, best-effort ONLY. SDK shape (officialDocsConsulted): import { Resend } from 'resend'; const r=new Resend(apiKey); const {data,error}=await r.emails.send({from,to,subject,html}); it returns {data,error}, never throws on API error -- but a network error CAN throw, so wrap in try/catch AND check error. The client takes injectable deps (the Resend constructor / send fn) so test/notify/resend.test.ts mocks it without a real network hit (no requires:operator). Config surface mirrors CAM-101 merge_mode EXACTLY (patterns.md 'Pure-helper extract for headless-testable setup steps', 'Optional 4th opts-bag', '[ship].merge_mode config surface'): setup.ts Step union + OPTIONS + SetupAnswers + collectViaReadline + collectViaInk + parseSetupArgs/--plan-approval flag (CAM-104 'Non-interactive init: mandatory answer + readline EOF rule': a new mandatory answer needs a CLI flag + build-release smoke update + readline 'close' EOF default, or non-interactive init hangs); config.ts mergeConfigChoices persists [plan] plan_approval + Resend keys; Ink SetupScreen.tsx + ConfigScreen.tsx add the selector blocks (Ink success/failure is the glyph, never divider color; verify render via ink-testing-library). Resend recipient/key likely persist to [plan] or a [notify] section in project.toml. LOUD WARNING: auto + unconfigured Resend -> printWarning that non-convergence failures are silent (CAM-104 gotcha: auto-as-default is bold, init MUST warn loudly + the auto safety net is mandatory). Runbook: add a scenario to docs/recovery-runbook.md for the auto pipeline + escalation. NO em-dash in persisted .md (runbook). Quality gate is `bun run check:all` (the full spine).
